passRule: A request passes when every hard check holds. Relevance (cN): each clearly relevant excerpt >= 0.6 (the product's bar: it is selected), each clearly irrelevant one <= 0.599. In effect on the ask's day (cN_now): each relevant, current excerpt >= 0.5 (it is not dropped as dated) and each wrong-time/version excerpt <= 0.499 (HARD: below the bar it is dated and never offered as the current answer). The set passes when all 3 requests pass. Near-miss relevance (<= 0.599) is soft: a miss is reported, never a failure. The note of every check starts with its kind.
